validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <parallel id="p">
    <state id="left">
      <state id="l1">
        <transition event="again" target="l1 l1"/>
        <transition event="nest" target="left l1"/>
        <transition event="done" target="done"/>
      </state>
    </state>
    <state id="right"><state id="r1"/></state>
  </parallel>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

notes: a target list names a set of states, so the repeat adds nothing: the state is entered once
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §3.11 Legal State Configurations and Specifications

diagnostics.message: transition targets `left` and `l1` are nested: `left` contains `l1`
notes: entering `l1` already enters `left`; each target of a multi-target set must lie in a different region of a common <parallel>, so a set that names a state and one of its descendants is rejected by the compiler
diagnostics.help: keep only one of these targets, or place them in different regions of a common `<parallel>` ancestor
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §3.11 Legal State Configurations and Specifications
